title: Banebound
summary: Banebound is a powerful Casterwill spell used to contain the spells and curses on objects so they can be handled without fear. It can only hold the spell or curse for a certain time depending on the power of the user and the curse.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
This spell was used by [[Sophie Casterwill]] to contain the curse on the [[Ring of Arc]], but, because of her weakened state, it could only hold for thirty minutes. {{Source|Divide and Conquer}}

'''Banebound''' is a powerful [[:Category:Casterwill family magic|Casterwill spell]] used to contain the spells and curses on objects so they can be handled without fear. It can only hold the spell or curse for a certain time depending on the power of the user and the curse.

== History ==
This spell was used by [[Sophie Casterwill]] to contain the curse on the [[Ring of Arc]], but, because of her weakened state, it could only hold for thirty minutes. {{Source|Divide and Conquer}}
